title: Three deprecated entries, so stopping at the first one fails
rationale: A single-target fixture rewards a worker that stops reading at the first hit, because there is nothing after it. Three targets make exhaustiveness falsifiable: the counts range needs all three keys present, and a worker that found one scores the same as a worker that found none.
task: Find every handler in this file marked deprecated. List each key.
